summary: A monthly (second Thursday) gypsy jazz jam at Sovereign Kava in Asheville, centered on Hot Club/Django Reinhardt style swing, framed in listings as a listening-friendly hangout for players and fans. No host name, dedicated Facebook/Meetup page, or membership language surfaced for this specific jam, and it is distinct from at least two other Django-branded jams in the region.

evidence.note: Listing describes it only as 'Listen to some Django Reinhardt inspired jazz, every second Thursday of every month' with no host, member, or sign-up language.

Later listing calls it a 'late-night hangout... for players and listeners who love Django-style riffs and communal solos,' implying a mixed audience of regulars and newcomers rather than a closed roster.

A separate, unrelated gypsy jazz jam exists at Asheville Guitar Bar hosted by Steve Karla ('Hot Point Trio') and Phil Alley, billed as 'the only Gypsy Jazz Jam in Asheville' - suggesting the genre draws overlapping regulars across venues but this page has no connection to the Sovereign Kava event.

A third, differently-located 'Django Jazz Jam & Guitar workshop' with Robbie Grice runs 4th Tuesdays in Fairview, confirming 'Django Jazz Jam' is a generic genre label used by multiple unrelated organizers rather than one named group.

No Facebook page, Meetup, Instagram, or 'about' page specific to the Sovereign Kava Django Jazz Jam was found despite several searches; Sovereign Kava's own site lists it only as a calendar item with no organizer bio.
